changes: Enforce channel-bound Release suites, Valid-Until freshness and a monotonic snapshot generation floor in apt through aurora-apt-guard and /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/90aurora-repo-guard.
notes: keys/aurora-debian-archive.asc is the owner's production public key (keys/README.md). A local development build adds keys/development.asc from scripts/dev-signing-key; it is never committed, and publication refuses a keyring that contains it.
